scope: Phase 4 screens: Logging (header, set rows, keypad, rest sheet and bar, plates, exercise/set/text/rest-time sheets, reorder), mini bar, Finish, Generate, History, Workout detail, Edit workout, hub start options, exercise History tab, Profile history row, Settings → Training (bar, plates, rest sound); base Sheet
scoreNote: Mean 3.7 (A); no open high. Before the fix pass: two open highs (FINDING-010, -011) capped Design at B.

findings.summary: Settings → Training 'Default rest' was saved but read by nothing (dead setting)
Hub Routines heading holds a reorder icon plus two text buttons; likely to crowd or wrap at 360dp Android widths
Chip touch target is 32pt + 4pt hitSlop (40pt), under 44pt; used for the rest and folder chips
Training settings changed offline wait silently (mutation paused) with no 'saves when you're online' note
findings.fixedIn: Phase 4 (Settings → Training shows a saving/offline note)

findings.summary: ReorderList doesn't auto-scroll while dragging, so long routine lists need several drags (Move up/down actions still work)
Swipe action reads 'Copy' but the menu and screen-reader action say 'Duplicate'
Warm-up (warning orange) and top-set (primary orange) badges are two close oranges side by side
Starter routine 'Added' stays tappable and adds another copy
'No colour' option uses a ban icon that reads as 'forbidden'
Rename and note sheets: the keyboard covered the input and Save (base Sheet had no keyboard avoidance; Phase 3 folder sheet affected too)
In an empty or generated workout, ticking set 2 saved no weight: suggestions ignored the set just lifted
'Turn on' in the rest sheet's notification prompt was invisible (secondary button on a raised panel)
The up-next ring added 2px and shifted that row's cells out of line
Done sets showed grey suggestions as if they were logged values
Calories missing: the bodyweight cache never filled; the weigh-in hint showed on past workouts
History rows had no duration (only the server computed it)
Edit workout: swipe or Android back could drop edits without asking
Generator shows 'Nothing fits yet' while the exercise library is still loading on a first launch (needs a loading state)
Rest sheet opens after every set (as briefed); consider a setting to start rests in the bar
Logging set row (badge, Last, 3 cells, tick) is unverified at 360dp Android widths and 1.6x text; may crowd
Volume had no digit grouping ('1200 kg')
Generator rep range used an en-dash ('6–10'); editor uses '8-10'
Save toast said 'syncs when you're online' even when online
History is a stack of cards (each workout is a discrete tappable object, consistent with routine cards)
Signing out drops unsynced workouts (and routines) with no warning; warn when the outbox has items
findings.fixedIn: Phase 4 (Settings → Account sign-out checks the outbox: 'Try to sync first' or 'Sign out anyway', confirmSignOut in src/lib/auth)

dismissedGrepHits: en dash in rep ranges (8–10) and the empty-cell marker: numeric ranges, not prose dashes
ScrollView + map in ReorderRoutinesScreen, TemplatesScreen, SummaryFooter: bounded lists (user's routines, 10 templates, at most 20 muscles)
Alert.alert in WorkoutScreen and RoutineBuilderScreen: destructive confirmations only
unverified: Android (no emulator run): 360dp widths, back button, keyboard
light mode on the new screens
rest notification delivery (permission left to the user)
real 60-minute session, airplane mode and phone restart
